# PDF fixtures

Copied from otf-pdf's test corpus (Apache-2.0,
https://github.com/Open-Tech-Foundation/PDF/tree/main/corpus), where each is
generated by a committed script:

| File | otf-pdf source | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `hello.pdf` | `malformed/minimal-valid.pdf` | One page, "Hello" in Helvetica |
| `damaged.pdf` | `malformed/wrong-xref-offsets.pdf` | Every xref offset wrong; opens with a repair |
| `not-a-pdf.pdf` | `malformed/not-a-pdf.pdf` | PostScript, no header |
| `flate-bomb.pdf` | `malformed/flate-bomb.pdf` | 64 MiB of zeros in a 64 KiB stream |
| `r6-aes-256.pdf` | `encrypted/r6-aes-256.pdf` | AES-256 (R6); user `user`, owner `owner`; text "Secret r6-aes-256" |
| `r4-rc4-128.pdf` | `encrypted/r4-rc4-128.pdf` | RC4 (R4), read but never written; same passwords |
| `japanese.pdf` | `text/japanese-chromium.pdf` | Japanese text printed by Chromium |

Outlines, scripts and attachments are built by the test itself (`rich_pdf`).
